description_en: Located just outside the Byāsī Gate on the northern periphery of Bhaktapur, this stone spout (hiti) was constructed in 1643 CE (NS 763) by Jāminī Mayī, a resident of Tupulāchi. The Byāsī Gate itself was part of a broader network of city gates built for Bhaktapur’s defense, and thehitisituated immediately beyond it is locally known as theByāsī Dhvākhā Pine Hiti—the drinking fountain outside the Byāsī Gate.Architecturally, thehitifeatures a west-facing single spout. The original ornamentalhiti-pusāthat once crowned the outlet is now lost. Directly beneath the spout is a statue of Bhagīratha, while an image of Umāmaheśvara (Śiva and Pārvatī) is placed above it. This central icon is flanked by Gaṇeśa on the north and Nṛtyeśvara (the dancing form of Śiva) on the south. A Viśveśvaraliṅgais located to the southeast of the fountain, and a smalljaḥdhuṇ(shrine niche) is embedded in the northern wall.An inscription from the time of thehiti’s construction records that Jāminī Mayī not only commissioned the water fountain but also installed the sacred images of Umāmaheśvara and Viśveśvara Mahādeva. The text issues a warning that any act of desecration or damage would invite the wrath of Umāmaheśvara, Viśveśvara, and Cāmuṇḍādevī.Despite its historical and religious significance, thehitihas remained dry for several decades. Occasional monsoon rains may fill it partially, but the water is not potable. No efforts have been undertaken by the municipality, ward office, or other responsible institutions to restore or maintain the site.
description_ne: भक्तपुरको ब्यासी ढोका बाहिर बाहिर अवस्थित यो हितिको निर्माण नेसं ७६३ (सन् १६४३) मा जामिनी मयीले गरेकी थिइन् ।भक्तपुर नगरलाई सुरक्षा दिन विभिन्न दिशामा बनाइएका ढोकामध्ये उत्तर दिशामा बनाइएको ब्यासी ढोका पनि एक हो । त्यसै ब्यासी ढोकाबाहिर एउटा हिति बनाइएको छ । ब्यासी ढोकाभन्दा बाहिर बनाइएकोले उक्त हितिलाई स्थानीयहरू ब्यासी ध्वाखा पिने हिति (ब्यासी ढोका बाहिर रहेको ढुङ्गेधारा) भन्ने गर्छन् । यस हितिमा पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी एउटा मात्र टुटी बनाइएको छ । टुटीमाथि राखिएको हितिपुसा पनि हराइसकेको छ । टुटीमुनि भगीरथको मूर्ति राखिएको छ भने टुटीभन्दा माथि उमामहेश्वरको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । उमामहेश्वरको उत्तरमा गणेश र दक्षिणमा नृत्येश्वरको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । हितिको दक्षिणपूर्वमा विश्वेश्वर शिवलिङ्ग र उत्तरपट्टि भित्तामा एउटा सानो जःधुं स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो हिति नेसं ७६३ (सन् १६४३) मा भक्तपुर तुपलाछि निवासी जामिनी मयीले यो हिति निर्माण गरी उमामहेश्वर र विश्वेश्वर महादेव स्थापना गरेकी थिइन् । हिति स्थापना गर्दा राखिएको अभिलेखमा कसैले हिति बिगारेमा उसलाई उमामहेश्वर, विश्वेश्वर महादेव र चामुण्डादेवीको कुदृष्टि लाग्ने चेतावनी पनि दिइएको छ ।केही दशकअघि नै यस हितिमा पानीको प्रवाह बन्द भइसकेको थियो । वर्षायाममा केही पानी झरेपनि खान योग्य नहुनाले यो हिति प्रयोगविहीन अवस्थामा रहेको छ । नगरपालिका, वडा कार्यालय लगायत कुनै निकायले पनि यस हितिको जीर्णोद्धार गर्न चासो देखाएका छैनन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: Sources and references Inscription identification number BKT0730_I_001 Sources Inscription dated to Nepal Saṃvat 763. Carved on two separate stone slabs: Below the image of Umāmaheśvara (H: 16 cm; W: 48 cm) Below the image of Gaṇeśa (H: 13 cm; W: 39 cm) Although the inscription is carved on two separate stones, the content indicates that they together constitute parts of a single inscription.
